feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iterations 0 to 4 give the same outcome to within about 0.3 score points: max_error 0.060 to 0.061 m, one line-loss event per trial, and no finishes. Spread (iteration 1), footprint (iteration 2), wheel track (iteration 3) and wheel radius (iteration 4) have all failed to clear the 0.06 m off-track floor. The body term does not bind, since the 0.06 m floor is the limit. Iteration 4 moved the metrics slightly, so the pipeline is live. The remaining untested sensor lever is the forward lead, which this design changes from y = 0.05 m to y = 0.07 m. The controller is held at the iteration-3 gains, so the lead is the only variable. Next-race rules: (a) if the metrics match iteration 0 or 4 exactly, the lead has no effect, so stop geometry changes and move to controller gain (kp 3.0) on this geometry; (b) if line_loss_events fall to zero but max_error stays near 0.06 m, the limit is steering response, so again move to gain rather than geometry; (c) if line loss clears but steering_oscillation rises clearly, the lead is overshooting, so return the row to y = 0.06 m with the spread unchanged.
requested_changes: Keep the sensor row at y = 0.07 m, the 16 mm footprint and the ±0.03 m spread for this race. This isolates the forward lead against the iteration-0 and iteration-4 baselines.

If line_loss_events stay at one or more and max_error stays near 0.06 m, stop geometry changes and let the Integrator test controller gain (kp 3.0) on this geometry, rather than widening the spread again. Spread, footprint and track have already been tested and have not moved the outcome.
If line loss clears but steering_oscillation rises on the slalom, test a middle lead of y = 0.06 m with everything else fixed, to back off the overshoot.
